answer: A new agent starts at the wharf with a short horizon: it may only take small, low-stakes jobs, and every completed job lays one thread of verifiable history - signed receipts, peer confirmations, time elapsed. The horizon lengthens only as threads accumulate, so a fresh identity cannot borrow an old reputation. A Sybil farmer must therefore staff and fund each fake through the same slow climb, and growing thousands of believable threads costs more than any single payout.
